_about: Research fixture: a synthetic parcel-desk project with two roles, three screens, three jobs, two rules (one open question, one ASSUMPTION, one assumed parameter), a flow with one open coverage warning, and demo entries. Invented names only. Drives tests/research_tool.py.

userInsights.quantitative: Existing note: 41 deliveries were logged in the pilot week.
userInsights.executiveSummary: Existing note: the pilot ran for one week.

jobs.want: see how much cash to collect
jobs.so: I do not ask them twice
jobs.gap: We assume the amount must be on the first screen.

rules.title: Cash limit per courier
rules.summary: A courier carries at most a fixed amount of cash.

decision.question: What is the cash limit?
decision.why: ASSUMPTION: couriers rarely carry more than the limit.
stillOpen: Does the limit differ by region?

rules.title: Handover states
rules.summary: A parcel is handed over once.

decision.question: When is a parcel handed over?

scenarios: The amount is shown before payment.
